title: Mini Golf
author: cobanov
description: Nine hand-made minigolf holes with ramps, hills, bumpers, water and spinning obstacles: time the swinging power meter and sink every putt under par.

controls.D-pad: Aim (LEFT / RIGHT turn, UP / DOWN fine-tune)
controls.A: Hold to charge, release to putt / start / next hole
controls.B: Cancel a charged putt / back to title (paused or final card)
